title: Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino (Remote)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <p>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Primary Focus:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.</p> <p>This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.</li> <li>Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.</li> <li>Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.</li> <li>Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.</li> <li>Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.</li> <li>Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.</li> <li>Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.</li> <li>Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs</li> <li>Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.</li> <li>Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.</li> <li>Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.</li> <li>Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.</li> <li>Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How This Role Connects Across the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.</li> <li>Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.</li> <li>Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.</li> <li>Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.</li> <li>Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.</li> <li>Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that’s optimised for performance (via creative briefs)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.</li> <li>Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.</li> <li>Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.</li> <li>Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.</li> <li>Experience managing and developing direct reports.</li> <li>Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>#li-JM3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Client Complaint Senior Analyst
description: Trust unlocks our greatest potential. For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution. What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’ What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our Client Services team as a Client Complaint Senior Analyst? Reporting to the Associate Director, Client Support you will take independent ownership of client complaints, using your judgement and complaints expertise to resolve non-routine cases fairly, effectively and within relevant requirements. You will support consistently high standards across complaint handling by identifying themes and improvements, sharing your knowledge and providing direct line management, day-to-day support and coaching to the Complaint Analyst. Your role includes: Independently manage client complaints from receipt through to resolution, applying sound judgement to deliver fair, timely and well-evidenced outcomes in line with complaint handling standards, relevant requirements and internal policies Investigate non-routine complaints, bringing together information from systems, teams and stakeholders to establish root cause, reach appropriate conclusions and identify when complex matters require escalation Produce clear, accurate and customer-focused written responses, ensuring decisions and outcomes are appropriately supported and communicated Identify recurring complaint themes, risks and root causes, using insight from cases to suggest practical improvements to customer outcomes, service quality and complaint management processes Take direct line management responsibility for the Client Complaint Analyst, setting clear objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, providing feedback and coaching, and supporting their onboarding, performance and development Share complaints knowledge and best practice across the team while continuing to manage your own complaint caseload Support consistent complaint handling standards across the team by providing guidance on day-to-day cases and constructively challenging where an approach may not achieve the right outcome Build trusted relationships across Client Services, Financial Crime, Operations, Product and other relevant teams to resolve issues and support improvements that benefit customers and the Bank What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Strong working knowledge of complaint handling in a customer service, financial services, operations or regulated environment, with the ability to apply relevant processes, policies and controls independently Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including the ability to investigate non-routine issues, assess evidence, identify root causes and reach well-reasoned conclusions Sound judgement, with the confidence to make day-to-day decisions independently and recognise when a more complex or higher-risk matter should be escalated Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and produce high-quality customer communications Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage varied complaint activity and competing priorities while maintaining quality and timeliness A collaborative approach, with the ability to line manage the Complaints Analysts, set clear expectations, provide constructive feedback and coaching, and support their performance and development Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, challenge constructively and suggest better ways of working What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you? You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank; You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care; You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate; ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary. Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time. What we offer in return: We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance. Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid. Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays. Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most. Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period. Socials – Regular social events open to all. Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice. Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection. Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you. Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts. Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave. Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning. And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! Equal Opportunities ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. The legal bit By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: People Analytics Analyst
description: People Analytics Analyst About Us ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly. We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. The role: Reporting to our Head of People, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight. Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team. You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information. Key Responsibilities Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities. Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion. Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders. Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis. Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control. Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality. Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations. Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience. Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity. Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls. What success looks like in the role: Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action. Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust. People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support. Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation. Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations. Skills & Experience: Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role. Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets. Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations. Strong Excel / Databricks capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome. Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups. description: About Keyrock Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management. We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement. We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it. What we are looking for We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities. The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation. You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization. We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale. Role description Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines. Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation. Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities. Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk). Background and Experience Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts) . Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes. System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure. TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure. Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments. Competences and personality Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role. Our recruitment philosophy We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility. Our offer A competitive salary and global benefit package Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities Autonomy in your time management thanks to semi-flexible working hours= Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process. As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>TransferGo</strong> is a growing fintech scale-up on a mission to champion financial freedom with care. Having this strong team of employees, we can serve those who really need our product to make their lives better. </p></div><p>Join us as a Senior Product Designer and help shape how money moves across the globe 💸.</p> <p>At TransferGo, Product Design is not simply a service that turns requirements into screens. usability</li> <li>Strong systems thinking, including an understanding of how design decisions affect connected journeys, platforms, teams and future product development</li> <li>Advanced proficiency title: Commercial Partnerships & Events Manager
description: About Adclear At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'. Founded in 2024, we already work with leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken and Coinbase. We've raised 2.6m and we're scaling fast. Now we need someone to take our name into the rooms where our buyers are, and turn those rooms into pipeline. The role Field marketing and partnerships are two of the biggest levers in how Adclear goes to market. Our breakfasts, dinners and panels are where compliance and marketing leaders from banks, lenders and fintechs meet us, meet each other, and see what modern compliance looks like. Our partnerships with compliance bodies, industry voices and marketing institutions carry our name into conversations we're not yet part of. This role owns both, and is measured on what they produce commercially: the right people in the room, warm conversations handed to sales, and opportunities in the pipeline. Running a great event matters, but it's the starting point, not the job. We run around three events a quarter. You'll decide who we need to reach, build the event or partnership that gets us in front of them, fill it, work the room, and make sure the conversations turn into meetings. This is an early-stage seat. You'll be a team of one on this, working directly with the founders and commercial team, and you'll pick up whatever it takes to make go-to-market work, even when it isn't strictly on the brief. Have a look at our LinkedIn and socials to see what we already do, then imagine what you'd do with it. What you'll do Field marketing Own the field marketing calendar: around three events a quarter across breakfasts, dinners and panels, plus third-party events and conferences where our buyers already gather. Start from the pipeline, not the venue: agree with the founders and sales which accounts and personas each event is for, and design the theme and format to land with them. Fill the room with the right people. Build target lists with sales, invite personally, chase RSVPs and find another way in when the first one doesn't work. Work the room on the day: make introductions, spot buying signals and connect guests with the right person at Adclear. Turn conversations into meetings: run follow-up with sales, so every event produces booked calls and new opportunities. Get the event done well: venue, speakers, run of show, suppliers and budget, without letting logistics become the job. Create the assets yourself where it's quicker: invites, event graphics and social posts. Partnerships Own relationships with compliance bodies, industry influencers and marketing institutions, from first outreach to co-hosted events, joint content and referrals. Prioritise partners by commercial value: who gives us access to the buyers and accounts we want. Spot and pitch new partnership opportunities, and negotiate what each side gets out of it. Commercial impact Track what each event and partnership produces: who came, meetings booked, pipeline created, deals influenced. Report back to the founders and use the numbers to decide what we do more of, change, or stop. Pitch in across go-to-market wherever you can add value, from campaigns to content to sales support. What we're looking for Startup or scale-up experience. You've worked in a small, fast-moving team where you wore several hats and got things done without a big budget or a support team behind you. Commercial instinct. You think in terms of accounts, pipeline and outcomes. You know the difference between a full room and a room full of buyers, and you care about the second. Hustle. You don't wait for RSVPs to arrive. You chase, follow up, and find another way in. Confident with senior people. You're comfortable walking up to a Head of Compliance at a bank, starting a real conversation, and making the right introduction. You can plan an event, write the invite, design the graphic, negotiate with a partner and update the CRM, sometimes all in the same day. Organised under pressure. There's always one event being planned, one being filled and one being followed up. You keep them all moving. Ownership. You treat every event and partnership as yours, including the results. How we work London, 4 days a week in our Farringdon office. Founders are closely involved day to day, and you'll work directly with them and the commercial team. You own your events and partnerships from day one, including the results. Your wins will be visible and celebrated across the company and the market. This isn't the right role if you want a fixed lane or a strict 40-hour week. Events mean the occasional early breakfast and late dinner. title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist. This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build. What You'll Build Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments. Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations. Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models. Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms. Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance. What Sets You Apart Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software. Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing. Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads. Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust. Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost. What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private healthcare We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all. description: <p>P-1584</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. And we're only getting started.</p> <p>Lakebase enables teams to deliver applications faster with an optimised database developer experience, integration with the lakehouse, and simplified operations. It provides a managed Postgres transactional layer for application state and workloads that combine operational data, analytics, and AI. You'll join as one of the founding leaders building out both the Lakebase product and our London presence.</p> <p>This is a Tech Lead Manager role: a hands-on technical leader who guides a small team of around five engineers while staying deep in the engineering work. You'll spend the majority of your time hands-on — driving architecture and design, solving the hardest problems in your team's projects, aligning with partner teams on dependencies, and writing code — and the rest leading and growing the engineers around you, who will report directly to you. It's  role for a strong senior engineer who wants to lead a team and take on people management without stepping away from the technical work.</p> <p>The team you will lead (one of):</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lakebase Platform Reliability (LPR)</strong> — Constantly evolve Lakebase reliability: cross-functional infrastructure, observability, SLI/SLO definition and measurement, and higher operational efficiency without humans-in-the-loop, for both internal and customer-facing systems, by building AI-powered automation and services.</li> <li><strong>Lakebase Proxy</strong> — Build the heart of the Lakebase data path, the network edge that every customer touches. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our Amazon MGM International team as a Senior Client Executive. This is a full-time position based in London. The Role will report to the Client Director. This is an incredibly exciting time to join the team, as we scale and begin to work across a fantastic and varied film slate, with titles such as Hail Mary, Verity and The Thomas Crown Affair.</p> <p>This role assists in the oversight of all workstreams and helps to co-ordinate the delivery of projects from start to finish, working with our internal teams and local market colleagues to deliver excellence in execution.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Work with the OpenDoor and WPP network will be a key part of your day-to-day and enabling best practice and on-time delivery is critical.</p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with the local OpenDoor teams and the regional departments</li> <li>Support with socializing Global Campaign guidelines and the implementation in the market</li> <li>Collate best-in-class work across the network, elevate to regional clients, and roll out across markets</li> <li>Understand the Amazon ways of working as well as the responsibilities of our team to drive ongoing organization, quality and consistency for your clients</li> <li>Ensure accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reporting (weekly spend trackers and performance reports)</li> <li>Support the finance billing process to collate PO’s, update budget trackers, and monitor client billing</li> <li>Support in ensuring client and internal Status meetings are well prepared</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent organization and project planning skills.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li>Passion for innovation and a desire to challenge industry norms.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values draw on Amazon’s <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a> and WPP’s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP’s creative transformation and Amazon’s customer focus empower our people to challenge today’s conventions and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.</p> <p>XCM is Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM’s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Collaboration across OpenDoor and the wider WPP network is central to the role, with a strong focus on best practice, operational consistency and on-time delivery.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Campaign delivery and coordination:</strong> Coordinate regional XCM campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions across client, internal and local market teams.</li> <li><strong>Client service and communication:</strong> Act as a professional point of contact for client enquiries and requests, providing clear updates on campaign progress, deliverables and performance.</li> <li><strong>Regional planning and reporting:</strong> Coordinate the accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reports, including weekly spend trackers, performance reports and campaign status updates.</li> <li><strong>Operational setup and governance:</strong> Set up and maintain reporting templates, trackers, campaign documentation and ways of working; coordinate inputs, complete quality checks and support consistent data and processes across markets.</li> <li><strong>Finance and billing:</strong> Support finance processes by collating purchase orders, maintaining budget trackers, monitoring client billing, and escalating discrepancies or missing information.</li> <li><strong>Meetings and follow-up:</strong> Participate in and facilitate regular client, internal and creative agency meetings, preparing agendas and materials and documenting actions, owners and deadlines.</li> <li>Communicate Global Campaign guidelines to local market teams, clarify requirements and support consistent implementation across markets.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with regional departments, local OpenDoor teams and wider WPP partners, working effectively across locations and time zones.</li> <li>Develop a strong understanding of Amazon’s ways of working and the OpenDoor operating model to improve organisation, quality and consistency.</li> <li>Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.</li> </ul> <p>QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</p> <ul> <li>2–3 years’ experience in media planning, client management or account coordination, preferably within a network agency.</li> <li>Excellent organisational and project planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively.</li> <li>Awareness of the media and marketing industry, including key channels, emerging trends and planning principles.</li> <li>Ability to manage defined tasks independently and present outputs directly to clients or package them clearly for the wider team.</li> </ul> <p>BONUS POINTS</p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3634 - Associate Director, Implementational Planning, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong><em> </em></p> <p>Are you looking to join a high-performance experienced team, whose ambition is to be the most distinctive and admired data driven, Digital Planning team in the UK?</p> <p>This is your opportunity to accelerate our clients digital and data transformation strategy whilst developing our Digital Planning IP within Wavemaker.</p> <p>This role will suit candidates with deep digital or performance marketing expertise, with a strong track record of quality and innovation in implementational planning or activation. The role is stretching, giving candidates responsibility for the advancement of a client group’s whole Digital marketing output and the fitness of our operating model to deliver this.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><em> </em>Support the Digital Planning Lead to audit our clients digital maturity, through the WM-Operating System and Digital Maturity Framework, delivering a set of indicators and actions, that drive growth and ensure our clients are future-fit.</li> <li>Working with the digital planning lead and Nexus activation teams, support in the leadership of the overall digital channel investment and ensure WM commercial considerations are taken into account.</li> <li>Work with Wavemaker product owners and with Data Partners, to ensure the right capabilities and technology are in place on the account to advance Digital marketing.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Data & Tech teams, as well as identify new opportunities to advance our clients through the suite of Digital Analytics solutions.</li> <li>Work ‘upstream’ with Strategy & Planning to ensure outputs from Provocative Planning are translated into credible Digital marketing approaches.</li> <li>Work ‘downstream’ with Platform Leads and Nexus Activation teams to ensure that the Digital channel approaches are activated with rigour and innovation.</li> <li>Support the digital lead in ensuring that all Digital channels are fully integrated into weekly/monthly client updates and meetings (this includes Ecommerce, Affiliates, and OneSearch : PPC & SEO).</li> <li>Support a ‘fluid’ way of working with Platform activation resource within each client hub.</li> <li>Being accountable to the Digital Planning Lead and Digital Planning Partner for the timely, high-quality delivery of digital marketing on the account.</li> <li>Support on new business pitches and help bring the strongest Digital solutions to our pitch RFI, RFP and presentations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Client Partnering and Consulting with Agency knowledge. <ul> <li>Responds to key Digital stakeholder requests in an accurate, timely and professional manner and seeks to have a good understanding of client needs and challenges. Gains stakeholder trust by responding to stakeholder requests and needs.</li> <li>Has a good understanding of how the agency operates and works with their clients. Knows about the clients’ business and who the key digital decision-makers are there.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li>Digital Channel Strategic thinking and Planning <ul> <li>Demonstrates an interest in client challenges by asking relevant questions and helps to gather insights to help aid digital planning. Follows instructions to meet client needs but is prepared and confident to challenge briefs. Builds digital case studies and gathers insights on clients to support the team and share learnings. Demonstrates understanding of digital campaign optimization strategies and how to meet key performance indicators. Uses big picture and critical thinking in day-to-day role, flagging and escalating potential issues in client work to team members.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li>Technical Knowledge of Products and Technical Communication skills <ul> <li>Has a good understanding of Xaxis, Nexus and Finecast product and service offerings and across all digital channels. Can discuss all digital channels, products and opportunities with confidence and can apply this knowledge to meet client/agency needs.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li>Commercial Acumen <ul> <li>Has a clear understanding of how finance works and how the agency makes a profit. Ensures exceptional finance management for digital clients and works with Nexus activation teams to ensure the finance process is adhered to, including any required booking, reconciling and documenting activity within deadline (including timesheets) and addressing finance queries. Demonstrates a growing understanding of the financial impact of decisions/solutions to drive projects and analyses that support the agencies mission. Understands GroupM’s trading strategies and processes.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li>Digital Industry Knowledge <ul> <li>Demonstrates basic understanding themes in the Digital industry (programmatic/Paid Search/ SEO/AI/digital media/platforms/Analytics). Research industry information and summarizes findings. Recognizes different digital products and services and begins to understand how they are applied.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li>Ideas Creation <ul> <li>Demonstrates curiosity by asking questions regarding current products/services and processes. Contributes to idea generation within team settings. Provides ideas and new solutions, methods and products to update what existed prior. Demonstrates willingness to try new and innovative ideas, products and solutions.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. title: Solution Architect (Commerce)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p><strong>Solution Architect (Permanent) </strong>with commerce experience wanted to join our Solution Archtiecture team, here at VML Enterprise Solutions </p> <p><strong>The opportunity:</strong></p> <p>A Solution Architect is required for a high-profile role giving the successful applicant the chance to lead the solution architecture for some of the world’s largest online brands and retailers and be an integral part of our talented and expanding Solution Architecture team.</p> <p>You will be responsible for creating and assuring solution architecture using a wide range of technologies, from SaaS eCommerce platforms through to client-specific cloud solutions. You’ll develop relationships with key client-side stakeholders in charge of IT and digital strategy and architecture, and you’ll work closely with our internal delivery teams to ensure your architecture vision is realised</p> <p>Our Solution Architecture team not only focus on delivery but also work with our clients in delivering the best consulting advice to ensure world class solutions that enable our clients to transact more digitally.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working on large-scale digital transformation programmes with global clients, designing solutions for all the opportunity and complexity this brings</li> <li>Own the solution architecture, document it, and communicate that architecture to a wide range of audiences</li> <li>See out and develop relationships with key client stakeholders responsible for digital and architecture strategy</li> <li>Orchestrate and run design workshops, and translate business strategy and requirements into solution architecture</li> <li>Ensure your architecture vision is realised by our teams, across all phases of programme delivery</li> <li>Understand common problems, design patterns and considerations for a distributed eCommerce architecture and apply this knowledge to your solutions</li> <li>Understand the level at which solution architecture applies, and help transition your solutions to application and cloud architects and technical leads</li> <li>Make and justify key architectural decisions considering all relevant constraints</li> <li>Follow the principles and guidance set out by the Solution Architecture team</li> <li>Contribute to the initiatives of our Solution Architecture team, including developing common patterns for new technologies and developing PoCs against industry trends.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we want from you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Core understanding of the capabilities of a wide range of technologies typically found within an eCommerce landscape, including enterprise eCommerce platforms and components, and apply this knowledge to your solutions</li> <li>Proven experience of solution ownership,</li> <li>Experience delivering solution transformations, roadmaps and (or) Integration strategies</li> <li>Understand the capabilities of public cloud platforms and be an advocate of cloud-native solutions</li> <li>Proven experience Designing quality solutions, often large scale and transactional in nature, for global enterprise clients</li> <li>Be client and delivery focussed, able to adapt a solution to meet additional requirements and constraints and apply pragmatism when required</li> <li>Prior experience running design workshops </li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills </li> <li>Have excellent communication, presentation and documentation skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you know some of this, even better:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with OMS</li> <li>Experience with PIM</li> <li>Specific Solution Architecture experience with the following technologies:</li> <li>React, Next.js, GraphQL (incl. federated), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Sanity.io, GCP</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you:</strong></p> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only:</strong></p> <p>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our personality and behaviours: We believe that we are what we do, not just what we say. Our shared values and behaviours show how to bring the VML Enterprise Solution's culture to life through the actions we all take every day:</p> <ul> <li>Connect Meaningfully</li> <li>Inspire Creatively</li> <li>Include Purposefully</li> <li>Approach Positively</li> </ul> <p>Our brilliant, talented people are what makes VML Enterprise Solutions what we are. That’s why we look for people who go beyond and always push our thinking to be better than yesterday.</p> <p><strong>About VML Enterprise Solutions:</strong></p> <p>Welcome to VML Enterprise Solutions, a multi-award-winning powerhouse of innovation, creativity and growth through technology in an ever-evolving world.</p> <p>Over 7,000 employees across VML’s global offices support VML Enterprise Solutions by helping to create and deliver digital transformations, Artificial Intelligence applications and technology solutions that introduce new operational efficiencies to organisations around the world.</p> <p>Our mission is to inspire global audiences to embrace and advance the world of online and offline shopping through seamless digital experiences and tech innovation. To achieve this, we work with many of the most exciting brands, such as The Coca-Cola Company, Ford, DFS, Dr. Martens, Johnson & Johnson, Mars, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges and Unilever..</p> <p>We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $56.5bn annually for our clients. We also work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify, Sitecore, Optimizely, BigCommerce, Commercetools and Acquia.</p> <p><u>If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</u></p> <p><em>At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction.</em></p> <p><em>VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit </em><a href="http://www.vml.com/"><em>our website</em></a><em>, and follow VML on our social channels via </em><a href="https://www.instagram.com/vml_global/"><em>Instagram</em></a><em>, </em><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/vmlyr/"><em>LinkedIn</em></a><em>, and </em><a href="https://twitter.com/vml_global"><em>X</em></a><em><u>.</u></em></p> <p><em>When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: Research Engineer
description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. What you’ll own Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved. Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. You should not apply if: You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership. Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting. You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself. You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes. You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions. You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works. We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days. Benefits Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. On Perplexity's Crawler team, you'll improve throughput, plan capacity, and build operational reliability through safer deployments, better observability, and durable fixes. Responsibilities Operate and optimize Kubernetes workloads and supporting infrastructure for crawler services, including fetching and rendering fleets. Build and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, with safe rollouts, validation, and fast rollback. Define SLOs and build monitoring, alerting, and observability for availability, latency, throughput, and resource saturation. Own capacity planning and resource efficiency; diagnose queue backlogs, network failures, and resource bottlenecks with service owners. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, lead incident response, and turn blameless postmortems into durable reliability improvements. Write production software to automate diagnosis and routine remediation, with validation and approval gates for high-impact actions. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or infrastructure-heavy backend roles, with strong programming skills in Python, C++, Rust, or Go. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, production Kubernetes, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and automated deployment workflows. Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, and load balancing. Experience building observability with tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana, and using SLOs to guide reliability improvements. Proven experience diagnosing distributed-system failures, leading production incidents, and improving system performance or resource efficiency. Nice to have Experience operating web crawlers, search infrastructure, or browser fleets at scale. Experience with distributed queues, backpressure, workload isolation, or multi-region recovery. title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)
description: Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems. Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale. Responsibilities Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs. Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes. Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably. Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors. Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests. Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements. Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++. Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions. Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits. Knowledge of page lifecycle, network idle, service workers, client-side rendering, and shadow DOM; experience debugging JavaScript and fluency with Chrome DevTools, CDP, HAR files, curl, and packet captures. Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined. Nice to have Experience developing CDN, caching, or web performance systems. Experience operating crawlers, headless browsers, or distributed content-acquisition systems at scale. Contributions to a browser engine or JavaScript runtime.
